title: MEIKO — Original Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Program Studio

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Welcome back to another episode of “Get on Those Hot Topics!”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Let's straight into it as we have a special guest with us here today! Please introduce yourself!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hello everyone! I'm MEIKO, the VIRTUAL SINGER!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Though I'm sure all of you already know, MEIKO will be performing in the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show, scheduled to be held in Shibuya!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Today, we hope to introduce our viewers to MEIKO, while also asking a variety of questions.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe, I look forward to it.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: With that goal in mind, we have gone out to the city and asked people about what comes to mind when they think of MEIKO. Let's have a look at the footage!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
What springs to mind when I think about MEIKO?
Hmm... I suppose an independent woman who rocks red!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Hmmm... I have this image of her being associated with alcohol.

rows.Speaker: Passerby C
rows.Line: True! Her outfits are always so attractive and she's really cool too. She's the kind of woman I look up to.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank you for all of your responses, everyone! It makes me happy to hear that I'm someone to look up to.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: A lot of people mentioned your maturity and attractiveness, which truly are some of your charming points.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: There were also a lot of people who said that they associate you with alcohol as well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. I suppose that's because some of the songs I sing include the subject in the lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: We have also received a message specifically for this program.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh, what does it say?>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: “Until a little while ago, I was frustrated and constantly crying about my lack of talent.”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: “But then I discovered MEIKO. Her voice had this strong determination and it really comforted me.”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: “I realized that, in order to make your dream come true, you also need to work on improving your skills. So I'm going to do my best and keep my head held high.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank you so much for the wonderful message! I'm so happy to hear that I was a source of comfort for you.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Putting in consistent effort to make your dreams come true is not an easy feat and I'm sure there will be some tough obstacles along the way, but I hope you give it your all and have no regrets!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Speaking of dreams, there's a special event that you will be holding during the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes! It's called the New Breeze & Reboot Festival! It's an exhibition that will be held right next to the concert venue.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <There will be paintings, photographs, sculptures and even wood prints. It'll be showcasing many works of art with us as their subjects.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: From up-and-coming artists to more seasoned creators who are making a comeback...

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: The news has been making the rounds since the initial announcement, hasn't it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <The New Breeze & Reboot Festival will also have a cafe area filled with comics and novels available for everyone to enjoy.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Delicious coffee, juice and finger foods will also be provided. Oh, alcoholic drinks are unfortunately not available, and don't you dare think about sneaking them in.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds like a recipe for a nice, relaxing reading session!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: By the way, even those who do not have concert tickets are welcome to enter the exhibition.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <There will be so many wonderful works there that it will truly be a feast for the eyes. So I hope you can make it!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: That's all for today, but we hope you look forward to the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show and...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <The New Breeze & Reboot Festival!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Host
rows.Line:
<Hope you can make it!>
Thank you!
